name: GyroSoul lit by the kind after its own
what: UNITE's check reads the chip's kind one up (Wind as Break): AirShot lights KnightSoul, which BN6's MegaMan does not hold, so GyroSoul never unites where BN5's does at t1

name: GyroSoul's passives left out
what: the proxy's passive entry runs none for GyroSoul where BN5's ready routine 0x08011BDC sets his flags 0x20 and 0x10 (Air and Float shoes) and updates his collision data: his object's flags
